What guests mention

What guests mention most

From the photos and what guests write in their Google reviews.

Steak and grill

5 Google reviews mention the fillet steak and 6 the souvlaki. One guest calls the steak the nicest they have ever eaten.

Meze to share

8 reviews mention the meze and 3 the meat meze. One guest writes that the meat meze for two is a portion for three to four people.

Sunset from the veranda

5 reviews mention the sunset view and 3 the view of the hills. Guests write about a beautiful view from the veranda.

How guests describe a visit

Generous portions

One guest writes that the food is exceptionally good and the portions are very generous.

Friendly staff

Guests write that the staff is friendly and attentive, and one says they feel like an old friend.

Fresh food

One guest calls the freshness of the food outstanding and the dishes super fresh.

On Coral Bay Avenue
